Jyutping: dong1 ngo5 gam2 dou3 soeng1 sam1 ge3 si4 hau6，ngo5 wui5 jat1 hai6 tai2 syu1，jat1 hai6 taan4 git3 taa1，jat1 hai6 heoi3 saan3 bou6，jat1 hai6 wan1 syu1，jat1 hai6 teng1 go1，jat1 hai6 tai2 hei3
Yale: dōng ngóh gám dou sēung sām ge sìh hauh，ngóh wúih yāt haih tái syū，yāt haih tàahn git tā，yāt haih heui saan bouh，yāt haih wān syū，yāt haih tēng gō，yāt haih tái hei
English 1: When I am feeling sad, I will either read, play guitar, go for a walk, study, listen to music, or watch a movie

Cantonese (Traditional): 我叫咗啲我最鍾意嘅童年電影嘅廣東話版。
Cantonese (Simplified): 我叫咗啲我最钟意嘅童年电影嘅广东话版。
Jyutping: ngo5 giu3 zo2 di1 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 tung4 nin4 din6 jing2 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 baan2。
Yale: ngóh giu jó dī ngóh jeui jūng yi ge tùngh nình dinh yíng ge gwóng dūng wá báan
English 1: I ordered the Cantonese version of some of my favorite childhood movies.

Cantonese (Traditional): 我冇任何寵物，但係我會嘗試餵我鎮上嘅流浪貓。
Cantonese (Simplified): 我冇任何宠物，但系我会尝试喂我镇上嘅流浪猫。
Jyutping: ngo5 mou5 jam6 ho4 cung2 mat6，daan6 hai6 ngo5 wui5 soeng4 si3 wai3 ngo5 zan3 soeng6 ge3 lau4 long6 maau1。
Yale: ngóh móuh yahm hòh chúng maht，daahn haih ngóh wúih sèuhng si wai ngóh jan seuhng ge làuh lohng māau。
English 1: I don't have any pets, but I try to feed the stray cats in my town.

Cantonese (Traditional): 如果我可以養寵物，我會養一隻黑貓。
Cantonese (Simplified): 如果我可以养宠物，我会养一只黑猫。
Jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 joeng5 cung2 mat6，ngo5 wui5 joeng5 jat1 zek3 haak1 maau1。
Yale: yùh gwó ngóh hó yíh yéuhng chúng maht，ngóh wúih yéuhng yāt jek hāak māau。
English 1: If I could have a pet, I would get a black cat.

Cantonese (Traditional): 如果黑貓畀人罵，噉我就想要佢哋嘅罵詞
Cantonese (Simplified): 如果黑猫畀人骂，噉我就想要佢哋嘅骂词
Jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 haak1 maau1 bei2 jan4 maa6，gam2 ngo5 zau6 soeng2 jiu3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 maa6 ci4
Yale: yùh gwó hāak māau béi yàhn mah，gám ngóh jauh séung yiu kéuih deih ge mah chìh
English 1: If black cats are cursed, then I would like their curse

Cantonese (Traditional): 我最鍾意嘅電影係歷史反戰電影。
Cantonese (Simplified): 我最钟意嘅电影系历史反战电影。
Jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 din6 jing2 hai6 lik6 si2 faan2 zin3 din6 jing2。
Yale: ngóh jeui jūng yi ge dinh yíng haih lihk sí fáan jin dinh yíng
English 1: My favorite movies are historical anti-war films.

Cantonese (Traditional): 我最鍾意嘅廣東樂隊係 My Little Airport 、 C-All Star 同 ToNick
Cantonese (Simplified): 我最钟意嘅广东乐队系 My Little Airport 、 C-All Star 同 ToNick
Jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 gwong2 dung1 ngok6 deoi2 hai6 My Little Airport ， C-All Star ，tung4 ToNick
Yale: ngóh jeui jūng yi ge gwóng dūng ngohk déui haih My Little Airport C-All Star tùngh ToNick
English 1: My favorite Cantonese bands are My Little Airport, C-All Star, and ToNick

Cantonese (Traditional): 除咗結他之外，我仲學緊彈奧卡里納。
Cantonese (Simplified): 除咗结他之外，我仲学紧弹奥卡里纳。
Jyutping: ceoi4 zo2 git3 taa1 zi1 ngoi6，ngo5 zung6 hok6 gan2 daan2 ou3 kaa1 lei5 naap6。
Yale: chèuih jó git tā jī ngoih，ngóh juhng hohk gán dáan ou kā léih naahp。
English 1: Besides Guitar, I am also learning to play the Ocarina

Cantonese (Traditional): 喺德國人哋飲好多啤酒，所以我喺呢度嘅時候都盡量唔好飲酒。
Cantonese (Simplified): 喺德国人哋饮好多啤酒，所以我喺呢度嘅时候都尽量唔好饮酒。
Jyutping: hai2 dak1 gwok3 jan4 dei6 jam2 hou2 do1 be1 zau2，so2 ji5 ngo5 hai2 ni1 dou6 ge3 si4 hau6 dou1 zeon6 loeng6 m4 hou2 jam2 zau2。
Yale: hái dāk gwok yàhn deih yám hóu dō bē jáu，só yíh ngóh hái nī douh ge sìh hauh dōu jeuhn leuhng m̀h hóu yám jáu。
English 1: In Germany people drink lots of beer, that's why I am trying to not drink alcohol while I'm here.

Cantonese (Traditional): 同美國相比，德國食煙嘅人多好多。
Cantonese (Simplified): 同美国相比，德国食烟嘅人多好多。
Jyutping: tung4 mei5 gwok3 soeng1 bei2，dak1 gwok3 sik6 jin1 ge3 jan4 do1 hou2 do1。
Yale: tùhng méih gwok sēung béi，dāk gwok sihk yīn ge yàhn dō hóu dō。
English 1: Way more people smoke cigarettes in Germany compared to the US.

Cantonese (Traditional): 三十歲前，我想去香港、深圳、廣州、重慶、成都、北京旅行。
Cantonese (Simplified): 三十岁前，我想去香港、深圳、广州、重庆、成都、北京旅行。
Jyutping: saam1 sap6 seoi3 cin4，ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2、sam1 zan3、gwong2 zau1、cung4 hing3、sing4 dou1、bak1 ging1 leoi5 hang4。
Yale: sāam sahp seui chìhn，ngóh séung heui hēung góng、sām jan、gwóng jāu、chùhng hing、sìhng dōu、bāk gīng léuih hàhng。
English 1: Before I turn 30 years old, I would like to travel to Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Chongqing, Chengdu, and Beijing.

Cantonese (Traditional): 我想去中國讀書或者搵實習，但係我唔知點樣。
Cantonese (Simplified): 我想去中国读书或者揾实习，但系我唔知点样。
Jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 zung1 gwok3 duk6 syu1 waak6 ze2 wan2 sat6 zaap6，daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 joeng2。
Yale: ngóh séung heui jūng gwok duhk syū waahk jé wán saht jaahp，daahn haih ngóh m̀h jī dím yéung。
English 1: I would like to study or find an internship in China, but I am not sure how.

Cantonese (Traditional): 我都係想令我嘅廣東話學習更加有效。
Cantonese (Simplified): 我都系想令我嘅广东话学习更加有效。
Jyutping: ngo5 dou1 hai6 soeng2 ling6 ngo5 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 hok6 zaap6 gang3 gaa1 jau5 haau6。
Yale: ngóh dōu haih séung lingh ngóh ge gwóng dūng wá hohk jaahp gang gā yáuh haauh
English 1: I am trying to make my Cantonese studying more effective.

Cantonese (Traditional): 雖然我永遠唔會放棄，但有時我仍然會努力保持動力。
Cantonese (Simplified): 虽然我永远唔会放弃，但有时我仍然会努力保持动力。
Jyutping: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 wing5 jyun5 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3，daan6 jau5 si4 ngo5 jing4 jin4 wui5 nou5 lik6 bou2 ci4 dung6 lik6。
Yale: sēui yìhn ngóh wíhng yúhn m̀h wúih fong hei，daahn yáuh sìh ngóh yìhng yìhn wúih nóuh lihk bóu chìh duhng lihk。
English 1: Although I will never give up, sometimes I still struggle to stay motivated.

Cantonese (Traditional): 我喺波士頓有啲朋友，但係大多數都係我爸爸掛住我。
Cantonese (Simplified): 我喺波士顿有啲朋友，但系大多数都系我爸爸挂住我。
Jyutping: ngo5 hai2 bo1 si6 deon2 jau5 di1 pang4 jau5，daan6 hai6 daai6 do1 sou3 dou1 hai6 ngo5 baa4 baa1 gwaa3 zyu6 ngo5。
Yale: ngóh hái bō sih déun yáuh dī pàhng yáuh，daahn haih daaih dō sou dōu haih ngóh bàh bā gwa jyuh ngóh。
English 1: I have some friends in Boston, but mostly it is my Dad who misses me.

Cantonese (Traditional): 如果講再見好痛，就代表你已經好好噉過咗你嘅時間。
Cantonese (Simplified): 如果讲再见好痛，就代表你已经好好噉过咗你嘅时间。
Jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 gong2 zoi3 gin3 hou2 tung3, zau6 doi6 biu2 nei5 ji5 ging1 hou2 hou2 gam2 gwo3 zo2 nei5 ge3 si4 gaan3。
Yale: yùh gwó góng joi gin hóu tung, jauh doih bíu néih yíh gīng hóu hóu gám gwo jó néih ge sìh gaan。
English 1: If a goodbye hurts, it means you've spent your time well

Cantonese (Traditional): 你值得被人揀、爭取同愛，就算有啲人令你諗唔同嘅嘢。
Cantonese (Simplified): 你值得被人拣、争取同爱，就算有啲人令你谂唔同嘅嘢。
Jyutping: nei5 zik6 dak1 bei6 jan4 gaan2, zang1 ceoi2 tung4 oi3, zau6 syun3 jau5 di1 jan4 ling6 nei5 nam2 m4 tung4 ge3 je5。
Yale: néih jihk dāk beih yàhn gáan, jāng chéui tùhng oi, jauh syun yáuh dī yàhn lihng néih nám m̀h tùhng ge yéh。
English 1: You are worthy of being chosen, fought for, and loved, even if some people made you think differently.

Cantonese (Traditional): 有時你會覺得自己想消失，但係你真正想要嘅只係被人搵到。
Cantonese (Simplified): 有时你会觉得自己想消失，但系你真正想要嘅只系被人揾到。
Jyutping: jau5 si4 nei5 wui5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 soeng2 siu1 sat1, daan6 hai6 nei5 zan1 zing3 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 zi2 hai6 bei6 jan4 wan2 dou2。
Yale: yáuh sìh néih wúih gok dāk jih géi séung sīu sāt, daahn haih néih jān jing séung yiu ge jí haih beih yàhn wán dóu。
English 1: Sometimes you think that you want to disappear, but all you really want is to be found.

Cantonese (Traditional): 正常化靜靜地存在，唔使同任何人解釋自己。
Cantonese (Simplified): 正常化静静地存在，唔使同任何人解释自己。
Jyutping: zing3 soeng4 faa3 zing6 zing6 dei6 cyun4 zoi6, m4 sai2 tung4 jam6 ho4 jan4 gaai2 sik1 zi6 gei2。
Yale: jing sèuhng fa jihng jihng deih chyùhn joih, m̀h sái tùhng yahm hòh yàhn gáai sīk jih géi。
English 1: Normalize quietly existing without explaining yourself to anyone.

Cantonese (Traditional): 我希望你揀啲揀你嘅人。
Cantonese (Simplified): 我希望你拣啲拣你嘅人。
Jyutping: ngo5 hei1 mong6 nei5 gaan2 di1 gaan2 nei5 ge3 jan4。
Yale: ngóh hēi mongh néih gáan dī gáan néih ge yành
English 1: I hope you choose people that choose you.

Cantonese (Traditional): 人哋點對待你係佢哋嘅路，你點樣回應係你嘅。
Cantonese (Simplified): 人哋点对待你系佢哋嘅路，你点样回应系你嘅。
Jyutping: jan4 dei6 dim2 deoi3 doi6 nei5 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 lou6, nei5 dim2 joeng2 wui4 jing3 hai6 nei5 ge3。
Yale: yàhn deih dím deui doih néih haih kéuih deih ge louh, néih dím yéung wùih ying haih néih ge。
English 1: How others treat you is their path, how you respond is yours.

Cantonese (Traditional): 首先你畀佢痛，然後你畀佢走。
Cantonese (Simplified): 首先你畀佢痛，然后你畀佢走。
Jyutping: sau2 sin1 nei5 bei2 keoi5 tung3, jin4 hau6 nei5 bei2 keoi5 zau2。
Yale: sáu sīn néih béi kéuih tung, yìhn hauh néih béi kéuih jáu。
English 1: First you let it hurt, then you let it go.

Cantonese (Traditional): 唔好為咗一個暫時嘅感覺而破壞你嘅未來。
Cantonese (Simplified): 唔好为咗一个暂时嘅感觉而破坏你嘅未来。
Jyutping: m4 hou2 wai6 zo2 jat1 go3 zaam6 si4 ge3 gam2 gok3 ji4 po3 waai6 nei5 ge3 mei6 loi4。
Yale: mh hóu waih jó yāt go jaamh sìh ge gám gok yìh po waaih néih ge meih lòih
English 1: Don't ruin your future for a temporary feeling

Cantonese (Traditional): 有一日，你會繼續前進，得到療癒，並且容許自己喺自己內心搵到安寧。
Cantonese (Simplified): 有一日，你会继续前进，得到疗愈，并且容许自己喺自己内心揾到安宁。
Jyutping: jau5 jat1 jat6，nei5 wui5 gai3 zuk6 cin4 zeon3，dak1 dou2 liu4 jyu6，bing6 ce2 jung4 heoi2 zi6 gei2 hai2 zi6 gei2 noi6 sam1 wan2 dou2 on1 ning4。
Yale: yáuh yāt yaht，néih wúih gai juhk chìhn jeun，dāk dóu lìuh yuh，bihng ché yùhng héui jih géi hái jih géi noih sām wán dóu ōn nìhng。
English 1: One day, you will have moved on, healed, and allowed yourself to find peace within yourself.

Cantonese (Traditional): 再見唔係永遠，亦唔係結局，簡單嚟講就係我會掛住你，直到我哋再見面。
Cantonese (Simplified): 再见唔系永远，亦唔系结局，简单嚟讲就系我会挂住你，直到我哋再见面。
Jyutping: zoi3 gin3 m4 hai6 wing5 jyun5，jik6 m4 hai6 git3 guk6，gaan2 daan1 lai4 gong2 zau6 hai6 ngo5 wui5 gwaa3 zyu6 nei5，zik6 dou3 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 gin3 min6。
Yale: joi gin m̀h haih wíhng yúhn，yihk m̀h haih git guhk，gáan dāan làih góng jauh haih ngóh wúih gwa jyuh néih，jihk dou ngóh deih joi gin mihn。
English 1: Goodbyes are not forever, nor the end, it simply means I'll miss you until we meet again.

Cantonese (Traditional): 為咗有新嘅嘢開始，我哋要接受過去嘅嘢嘅結束。
Cantonese (Simplified): 为咗有新嘅嘢开始，我哋要接受过去嘅嘢嘅结束。
Jyutping: wai6 zo2 jau5 san1 ge3 je5 hoi1 ci2，ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zip3 sau6 gwo3 heoi3 ge3 je5 ge3 git3 cuk1。
Yale: waih jó yáuh sān ge yéh hōi chí，ngóh deih yiu jip sauh gwo heui ge yéh ge git chūk。
English 1: In order for something new to begin, we have to accept the end of something past.

Cantonese (Traditional): 消失都冇問題，直到你重新覺得自己係自己。
Cantonese (Simplified): 消失都冇问题，直到你重新觉得自己系自己。
Jyutping: siu1 sat1 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4，zik6 dou3 nei5 cung4 san1 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hai6 zi6 gei2。
Yale: sīu sāt dōu móuh mahn tàih，jihk dou néih chùhng sān gok dāk jih géi haih jih géi。
English 1: It's okay to disappear until you feel like yourself again.

Jyutping: zung6 mei6 gaau2 cing1 co2 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4
Yale: jungh meih gáau chīng chó dōu móuh manh tàih
English 1: It's okay to not have it all figured out yet.

Cantonese (Traditional): 喺成個宇宙入面，樹木無疑係比鑽石更有價值。
Cantonese (Simplified): 喺成个宇宙入面，树木无疑系比钻石更有价值。
Jyutping: hai2 seng4 go3 jyu5 zau6 jap6 min6，syu6 muk6 mou4 ji4 hai6 bei2 zyun3 sek6 gang3 jau5 gaa3 zik6。
Yale: hái sèhng go yúh jauh yahp mihn，syuh muhk mòuh yìh haih béi jyun sehk gang yáuh ga jihk。
English 1: In the entire universe trees are undoubtedly more valuable than diamonds.

Cantonese (Traditional): 你行幾快唔係好重要，重要嘅係你唔好放棄。
Cantonese (Simplified): 你行几快唔系好重要，重要嘅系你唔好放弃。
Jyutping: nei5 haang4 gei2 faai3 m4 hai6 hou2 zung6 jiu3，zung6 jiu3 ge3 hai6 nei5 m4 hou2 fong3 hei3。
Yale: néih hàahng géi faai m̀h haih hóu juhng yiu，juhng yiu ge haih néih m̀h hóu fong hei。
English 1: How fast you go isn't of great importance, what matters is that you don't give up.

Jyutping: mui5 jat1 dim2 zeon3 bou6 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3。
Yale: múih yāt dím jeun bouh dōu hóu jungh yiu

Cantonese (Traditional): 唔好為咗保暖其他人而自焚。
Cantonese (Simplified): 唔好为咗保暖其他人而自焚。
Jyutping: m4 hou2 wai6 zo2 bou2 nyun5 kei4 taa1 jan4 ji4 zi6 fan4。
Yale: mh hóu waih jó bóu nyúnh kèih tā yành yìh jih fành
English 1: Don't set yourself on fire trying to keep others warm.

Cantonese (Traditional): 你嘅自我愛一定要比你想畀人愛嘅慾望更強。
Cantonese (Simplified): 你嘅自我爱一定要比你想畀人爱嘅欲望更强。
Jyutping: nei5 ge3 zi6 ngo5 oi3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bei2 nei5 soeng2 bei2 jan4 oi3 ge3 juk6 mong6 gang3 koeng4。
Yale: néih ge jih ngóh oi yāt dingh yiu béi néih séung béi yành oi ge yuhk mongh gang kèungh
English 1: Your self love must always be stronger than your desire to be loved by others.

Cantonese (Traditional): 放低憤怒、後悔同擔心。人生轉瞬即逝，幸福值得堅持。
Cantonese (Simplified): 放低愤怒、后悔同担心。人生转瞬即逝，幸福值得坚持。
Jyutping: fong3 dai1 fan5 nou6、hau6 fui3 tung4 daam1 sam1。jan4 sang1 zyun2 seon3 zik1 sai6，hang6 fuk1 zik6 dak1 gin1 ci4。
Yale: fong dāi fáhn nouh、hauh fui tùhng dāam sām。yàhn sāng jyún seun jīk saih，hahng fūk jihk dāk gīn chìh。
English 1: Let go of anger, regret, and worry. Life is fleeting and happiness is worth holding onto.

Cantonese (Traditional): 有一日你會好開心你繼續前進，得到療癒，並且容許自己安寧。
Cantonese (Simplified): 有一日你会好开心你继续前进，得到疗愈，并且容许自己安宁。
Jyutping: jau5 jat1 jat6 nei5 wui5 hou2 hoi1 sam1 nei5 gai3 zuk6 cin4 zeon3，dak1 dou2 liu4 jyu6，bing6 ce2 jung4 heoi2 zi6 gei2 on1 ning4。
Yale: yáuh yāt yaht néih wúih hóu hōi sām néih gai juhk chìhn jeun，dāk dóu lìuh yuh，bihng ché yùhng héui jih géi ōn nìhng。
English 1: One day you'll be happy you moved on, healed, and allowed peace in yourself.

Cantonese (Traditional): 任何人都可以愛一朵花，但係要愛一片葉，就要花好多時間。
Cantonese (Simplified): 任何人都可以爱一朵花，但系要爱一片叶，就要花好多时间。
Jyutping: jam6 ho4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 oi3 jat1 do2 faa1，daan6 hai6 jiu3 oi3 jat1 pin3 jip6，zau6 jiu3 faa1 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3。
Yale: yahm hòh yàhn dōu hó yíh oi yāt dó fā，daahn haih yiu oi yāt pin yihp，jauh yiu fā hóu dō sìh gaan。
English 1: Anyone can love a flower, but it takes a lot to love a leaf.

Cantonese (Traditional): 愛靚係普通，但愛平凡就係靚。
Cantonese (Simplified): 爱靓系普通，但爱平凡就系靓。
Jyutping: oi3 leng3 hai6 pou2 tung1，daan6 oi3 ping4 faan4 zau6 hai6 leng3。
Yale: oi leng haih póu tūng，daahn oi pìhng fàahn jauh haih leng。
English 1: It's ordinary to love the beautiful, but it's beautiful to love the ordinary.

Cantonese (Traditional): 呢個世界一向都充滿美好，但係你要留意佢嘅事。
Cantonese (Simplified): 呢个世界一向都充满美好，但系你要留意佢嘅事。

Cantonese (Traditional): 好好對待自己，休息足夠先可以好返。

Cantonese (Traditional): 記唔記得上次你以為自己做唔到，但係之後你做咗？
Cantonese (Simplified): 记唔记得上次你以为自己做唔到，但系之后你做咗？

Cantonese (Traditional): 你人生中一啲最好嘅日子仲未發生。

Cantonese (Traditional): 縱路途滿是困阻問題或變化
Cantonese (Simplified): 纵路途满是困阻问题或变化

Cantonese (Simplified): 只想停留身边和你走每一天继续上演

Cantonese (Simplified): 还没跟你相约他世再会梦已化烟

English 1: When you're in your darkest place, you give yourself hope and that's inner strength.

Cantonese (Traditional): 無論你喺邊度，無論你成功定唔成功，生活都會發生。
Cantonese (Simplified): 无论你喺边度，无论你成功定唔成功，生活都会发生。

Cantonese (Simplified): 保护同功率被高估。我觉得你好明智噉拣幸福同爱情。

Cantonese (Simplified): 系时候你要向内望，同埋开始问自己啲大问题。你系边个？同埋你想要啲咩!?
